data.title: 拉·芙利亚 · 王家寝宫的极乐沉沦
data.description: 雕花四柱大床厚重帷幔深处，半透冰丝睡袍褪落在地。傲视群雄的帝国王女在无尽的炙热攻伐中眼角泛着欢愉泪水，双手紧抱你的后颈，娇啼求饶却又深情呼唤“我的王夫”。
data.location: ancient royal castle bedchamber with gossamer silk canopy
data.action: tangled in deep silk bedding under canopy, silver hair intermingled, ecstatic teary eyes, arched back in intense pleasure
data.lighting: intimate flickering candelabras casting golden dancing shadows
data.mood: transcendent royal ecstasy, absolute lovers surrender, profound soulmate union
data.promptProse: Tangled in a grand canopy bed in candlelight, La Folia sheds tears of ecstasy with flushed cheeks, whispering her complete submission of love.
data.animaCaption: La Folia in ecstatic bridal surrender in a candlelit royal canopy bed.
